mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM appointment a JOIN schedule s ON a.schedule_id = s.id WHERE s.schedule_date = #{today} AND a.status <> 'cancelled'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM doctor WHERE status = 1 AND role_type = 'DOCTOR'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE role = 'USER' AND deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM appointment WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(DATE(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY name
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM appointment GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT d.name AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM appointment a JOIN schedule s ON a.schedule_id = s.id JOIN doctor dr ON s.doctor_id = dr.id JOIN department d ON dr.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT CAST(rating AS CHAR) AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM appointment_review GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating
